derived_from.title: Ulcerative-colitis public Reddit demand: validated 39-node question tree

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: General background exists, but UC-specific tests, monitoring, symptom-versus-inflammation, and triage pathways are incomplete.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I understand what my ulcerative colitis is doing and know when to seek care?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC-specific evidence pathway integrates symptoms, alternative causes, and escalation thresholds.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I recognize a possible flare and judge how urgently I need help?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Symptom descriptions exist, but symptoms alone cannot confirm inflammation.
nodes.normalized_question: Which symptom changes commonly make people suspect a UC flare?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No reviewed acute-severe-UC or emergency-triage evidence was identified in the package.
nodes.normalized_question: Which warning signs should prompt urgent or emergency assessment?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: All symptoms-versus-inflammation claims are Crohn’s-only; no UC-eligible pathway.
nodes.normalized_question: Could symptoms reflect infection, IBS overlap, medication effects, or something other than active inflammation?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC-eligible biomarker, colonoscopy, mucosal-healing, or ultrasound claims.
nodes.normalized_question: How should I understand monitoring results and whether I am in remission?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Fecal calprotectin and CRP claims are Crohn’s-only; ESR is absent.
nodes.normalized_question: What do fecal calprotectin, CRP, ESR, and other tests contribute to monitoring?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC-eligible evidence for colonoscopy, mucosal healing, or intestinal ultrasound.
nodes.normalized_question: Why might colonoscopy, biopsy, or imaging be recommended when symptoms or labs look reassuring?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: The package lacks UC-specific treat-to-target and mucosal-healing claims.
nodes.normalized_question: What is the difference between symptom control and clinical, endoscopic, or deeper remission?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: General condition knowledge exists; practical navigation, access, and escalation content is sparse.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I navigate diagnosis, appointments, and access to appropriate UC care?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: General UC/IBD background exists, but structured UC onboarding is incomplete.
nodes.normalized_question: What should a newly diagnosed person learn, track, and ask first?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No evidence-backed communication or second-opinion workflow is included.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I prepare for appointments, communicate worsening symptoms, or seek another opinion?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No access, insurance, formulary, or affordability evidence is included.
nodes.normalized_question: What can I do when treatment, specialist appointments, tests, or medicines are delayed or unaffordable?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Diet is partly covered at IBD-general level; UC-specific medicines, sequencing, monitoring, and surgery are largely absent.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I choose and manage strategies intended to control UC?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: The package contains no treatment or drug-class evidence for UC.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I understand a medicine, its expected course, and whether it is working safely?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC medicine-class evidence is included.
nodes.normalized_question: What should I expect when starting a UC medicine, infusion, injection, or new dose?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC medication safety or infection-screening evidence is included.
nodes.normalized_question: Which possible side effects or infection concerns need routine discussion versus urgent review?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC loss-of-response, therapeutic monitoring, or sequencing evidence exists.
nodes.normalized_question: How is inadequate response or loss of response assessed before changing treatment?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: IBD-general evidence covers fibre, dietary patterns, additives, probiotics, alcohol, and dairy; UC-specific and flare-nutrition pathways remain incomplete.
nodes.normalized_question: How should I think about food, nutrition, and symptom-trigger questions?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: General diet evidence exists, but it does not provide individualized flare diets.
nodes.normalized_question: What foods or meal patterns are commonly asked about during a flare?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Relevant IBD-general diet claims exist; UC-specific causal evidence and individualized guidance are limited.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I evaluate suspected trigger foods or restrictive diets during remission?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Some nutrition evidence exists, but a UC-specific deficiency and acute-intake pathway is incomplete.
nodes.normalized_question: When do weight loss, poor intake, dehydration, anemia, or nutrient concerns need specialist help?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Biologics, JAK inhibitors, standard maintenance therapies, loss of response, and surgery are absent.
nodes.normalized_question: When are escalation, long-term medicines, or surgery discussed?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC biologic or JAK-inhibitor evidence exists.
nodes.normalized_question: Why might biologics or small-molecule treatments be considered, and what questions help compare them?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC treatment-class or maintenance-therapy evidence exists.
nodes.normalized_question: How do steroids, mesalamine, rectal therapies, and medication adherence fit into short- and long-term management?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC surgery, ostomy, J-pouch, or pouchitis evidence is included.
nodes.normalized_question: When is colectomy discussed, and what questions compare ileostomy and J-pouch pathways?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Stress and quality-of-life evidence exists at IBD-general level; fatigue, work, reproductive health, complications, and prevention are incomplete.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I live well with UC in daily life, relationships, and major life stages?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Quality-of-life evidence exists, but fatigue evaluation and practical function tools are incomplete.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I manage fatigue, work or school, travel, and activity limitations?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: The package lacks a UC-specific fatigue assessment pathway.
nodes.normalized_question: How should persistent fatigue or brain fog be discussed and evaluated, including during remission?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: General quality-of-life evidence exists; workplace and education guidance is absent.
nodes.normalized_question: How can people plan for work, school, commuting, bathroom access, or accommodations?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC-specific travel or exercise evidence was identified.
nodes.normalized_question: How can travel, exercise, and activities be adapted when urgency or energy is unpredictable?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Stress and quality-of-life are covered generally; mental-health and relationship pathways are incomplete.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I handle the emotional, social, and relationship impact of UC?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: General stress/QoL evidence exists; no UC-specific mental-health care pathway.
nodes.normalized_question: How can anxiety, depression, embarrassment, or fear of accidents be addressed alongside UC care?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Relationship, disclosure, and intimacy content is not directly covered.
nodes.normalized_question: How can I talk with partners, family, friends, or colleagues about UC, intimacy, and boundaries?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Quality-of-life evidence exists, but structured coping and support guidance is limited.
nodes.normalized_question: How do people cope with uncertainty, isolation, and changes to their sense of normal life?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: Pregnancy, extraintestinal manifestations, cancer surveillance, vaccination, and infection-prevention evidence is not represented.
nodes.normalized_question: What long-term, reproductive, and whole-body questions should be planned for?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC reproductive-health or medication-in-pregnancy evidence is included.
nodes.normalized_question: What should be discussed before or during pregnancy, fertility treatment, breastfeeding, or postpartum care?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No extraintestinal-manifestation evidence was identified.
nodes.normalized_question: Could joint, skin, eye, mouth, or liver symptoms be related to UC, and who should assess them?

nodes.likely_evidence_gap: No UC-specific cancer-surveillance, vaccination, or infection-prevention evidence was identified.
nodes.normalized_question: What should I understand about colorectal-cancer surveillance, vaccines, and infection prevention over time?

note: Question tree is evidence of patient DEMAND only. `current_evidence_package_coverage` is the tree's own prior annotation; the Phase-2 evaluation does NOT use it (see MAPPING-DECISION.md).
